purpose: Independent calibration of within-window serial interleaving after whole-window A/A failed precision gate
calibration_rule: For each CPU metric, exact paired-run median rank interval with Bonferroni m=2 must fit within +/-0.5% for preliminary ability to study ~1% changes. Report every individual pair/outlier; passing is session/workload-specific, not universal accuracy or equivalence. No candidate data collected under this A/A plan. If not met, improve design/sample evidence before classifying effects near 1%.
statistical_unit: One physical paired window yields one ratio of sums across 20 equal-size segments per side. Eight independent windows; never treat 40 segments as 40 independent replicates.
preflight: After existing R99 memory/device windows: one paired smoke with n=1000 per segment; verify all 40 JSON results, two daemon identities, affinity, counts, returned states and cleanup before collecting n=10000.
production: stock C throughout; only new disposable namespace processes are pinned; no governor/IRQ/production affinity changes
failure_rule: Stop on identity, correctness, collection, health, affinity or cleanup failure. Preserve failed window; never infer success from missing results.
design: Two independent byte-identical daemons pinned CPU 1; one serial client pinned CPU 0. Ten quartets alternating slot ABBA/BAAB, 2000 untimed warmup cycles per segment. Randomized logical side assignment to slots per window. Identical source client as previous calibration. This co-resident comparison is a diagnostic condition, not production latency/memory acceptance.
previous_data: r99-registration-aa-results.json retained separately; no pooling, replacement or candidate-based selection
